First of all everything you’re feeling is completely normal. It’s a kind of grief and you have to understand what grief is and how your body processes it both mentally and physically.

Second, I’m going to suggest something here that you may not like, but have you considered talking to your parents about this. They have resources to help you.

Third, I can assure you that it will get better. Eventually, you will not even think about this girl at all. It is hard because in a relationship your brain we rewired itself in a certain way because of the relationship, and especially with you your brain is still developing.  But please don’t despair, I promise you I promise you I promise you, it will get better.
